expectation.note: MUST-level requirement. Engines that coerce silently produce a set the author did not write.

normative_evidence.quote: The value of the UNTIL rule part MUST have the same value type as the 'DTSTART' property.

rationale: A MUST that the ABNF cannot enforce, so it is hand-checked or not checked at all.
title: UNTIL value type mismatched with DTSTART (Z on a floating start)
